Version

December 11, 2007
Christmas Update 2007
See also: ObjectsHelp
You see a great mana potion.
It weighs 3.10 oz.
This potion can only be consumed by players of level 80 or higher.

  • Aaaah...

Notes

It has a deposit of 5 gp and restores between 150 and 250 Mana Points, around 200 on average.
See also: Money Spent per Mana Point and Capacity Taken per Mana Point

History

  • The price was further increased from 144 gp to 158 gp with the Summer 2024 Update on Jul 01, 2024.
  • Paladins gained the ability to consume these potions with the release of the Vocation Adjustments Update on November 23, 2020.
  • The price was increased from 120 gp to 144 gp, additionally the Store prices were also raised with the update on October 29, 2018 shown below.
    • 100x Great Mana Potions went from 9 Tibia Coins to 11 Tibia Coins.
    • 250x Great Mana Potions went from 21 Tibia Coins to 26 Tibia Coins.
  • As announced on June 16, 2026, the Vocation Adjustments Update 2026 removed its vocation requirements, all vocations can now use it.
